features: Connectivity: The ZEB-ATC1 features a USB Type-A connector on one end and a Type-C connector on the other, allowing easy connection between legacy devices and modern gadgets for seamless data transfer.
USB 3.0 support: The ZEB-ATC1 's USB 3.0 support offers faster file transfers and improved connectivity, making it ideal for those seeking reliable speed.
Backward Compatibility: Despite its advanced USB 3.0 capabilities, the ZEB-ATC1 maintains backward compatibility and can be used across a wide range of hardware without compatibility concerns.
High-Speed Data Transfer: The ZEB-ATC1 converter supports high-speed data transfer rates of up to 5Gbps* (*depending on device configuration), as specified by the USB 3.0 standard.
Plug-and-play: The plug-and-play feature of the converter makes it easier while enabling connection.
